content.pairing_note: Four color-balanced opening pairs, then one unpaired initial-position game with Jev as White (5 White, 4 Black).

draw_policy: Automatically claim current threefold repetition or 50-move rule; do not claim on an unplayed prospective move. Rules library also enforces stalemate, insufficient material, fivefold repetition and 75-move rule.
failure_policy: No substitute moves. Exhausted invalid responses and Jev timeouts are unrated failed games with a separate operational forfeit; HTTP, network, engine, worker, budget and harness failures are unrated infrastructure failures. Ply/time caps are censored, never draws.
